- Red strikers may not defend: they wait for the counter.
- When red win the ball, they counter into either mini-goal.
- Blue have 5 seconds to win the ball back before the counter is “on”.

Scoring:
- Blue: goal 1; regain inside 5 seconds 1; goal within 10 seconds of a regain 2.
- Red: mini-goal from a counter 2.

Link to our 2-3-2-3:
Our 2 + 3 behind the ball (centre-backs, fullbacks and 6) are the rest defence. They make counter-pressing safe: the strikers are watched while the nearest players press.

items.text:
REST DEFENCE
2 watch the
strikers, 3
screen the
middle.

steps.title: 19 Game · Rest defence & counter-press — Rest defence: 2 + 3 behind the ball
steps.note:
What happens:
While we attack, the two centre-backs watch their strikers and the fullbacks and 6 form a line of three in front of them.

Coaching points:
- Centre-backs: goal side of the strikers, close enough to step in front.
- The 3: compact, central, ready to block the first forward pass.
- Check before an extra player joins the attack: who covers the counter?

items.text:
LOST IT
Their holding
midfielder
intercepts.

steps.title: 19 Game · Rest defence & counter-press — Loss: the pass into the 9 is cut out
steps.note:
What happens:
The 10 forces a pass into the 9. Their holding midfielder steps across and wins it.

Coaching points:
- The loss is the trigger: no appeals, no turning away.

items.text: 5 SECONDS

COUNTER-PRESS
Nearest three
squeeze the
ball; the 6
screens; centre-
backs step
tight.

steps.title: 19 Game · Rest defence & counter-press — Counter-press: nearest three, 5 seconds
steps.note:
What happens:
The 10, the 9 and the 8 squeeze the ball carrier at once. Behind them the 6 blocks the pass into the strikers, and the centre-backs step tight.

Coaching points:
- Nearest player presses the ball, the next two close the inside passes.
- The 6 screens the pass to their strikers: his shadow covers them.
- Centre-backs step in front of the strikers: the long ball must be won in the air or on the ground.

items.text:
REGAIN · FORWARD
The 10 wins it
facing forward;
first pass in
behind.

steps.title: 19 Game · Rest defence & counter-press — Regain: forward at once
steps.note:
What happens:
The 10 wins the ball inside 5 seconds, facing their goal. The first pass goes forward at once, while their shape is open: the right winger runs in behind their left-back.

Coaching points:
- After a regain their team is spread: the first pass goes forward if it can.
- If not, secure the ball and rebuild.

items.text:
DELAY AND RECOVER
The 6 delays;
the back line
protects the
space; fullbacks
recover inside.

steps.title: 19 Game · Rest defence & counter-press — If the press is beaten: delay and recover
steps.note:
What happens:
This time their midfielder escapes the first press and looks for the strikers. The 6 delays him; the centre-backs drop to protect the space behind; the fullbacks recover inside first.

Coaching points:
- Delay: the nearest defender stops the ball going forward, he does not dive in.
- Recover inside first, then outside.
- One isolated press is worse than none: go together or drop together.

items.text:
PROGRESS
Three red
strikers ·
4-second window
· full-size
counter goal.

steps.title: 19 Game · Rest defence & counter-press — Coaching points and progressions
steps.note:
Coaching points:
- Rest defence: 2 watching the strikers, 3 screening the middle, always.
- The loss is the trigger; the nearest three press at once.
- The 6 screens the forward pass; the centre-backs step in front.
- After a regain, the first pass goes forward if it can.
- Beaten? Delay, protect depth, recover inside.

Progressions:
- Red strikers become three.
- Regain window shortened to 4 seconds.
- Red counter into a full-size goal with a goalkeeper.

Regressions:
- One red striker.
- Red must make two passes before they can shoot.

Dose:
3 x 7 min, 2 min rest.

items.text:
20 · 11v11 GAME
Our 2-3-2-3 against
a high 4-4-2. Bonus
goals for our
principles.

steps.title: 20 Game · 11v11 2-3-2-3 — Set-up
steps.note:
Organisation:
- Full pitch, 11v11. Blue in our 2-3-2-3; red in a 4-4-2 that presses high.
- 2 halves of 10 minutes, 3 minutes rest. Restart every goal kick from our goalkeeper.

Rules:
- Normal laws, offside on.
- Coaches call the bonus goals as they happen.

Scoring:
- Every goal: 1.
- Bonus +1: the move started with a bait (a presser committed to our goalkeeper or a centre-back) and an exit through a first-time set to a third man facing forward.
- Bonus +1: the goal came within 10 seconds of a switch to an isolated winger.
- Bonus +1: the goal came within 10 seconds of a regain made inside 5 seconds of losing the ball.
- Red: every goal 1; regain in our third and shot 1.

Link to our 2-3-2-3:
Everything in this manual in one game: bait the press, find the third man, isolate the winger, counter-press with the 2 + 3.

items.text:
1 · BAIT
GK holds; their
striker jumps and
blocks the LCB.

steps.title: 20 Game · 11v11 2-3-2-3 — Bait: the goalkeeper holds the ball
steps.note:
What happens:
The goalkeeper stops the ball under his sole. Their striker jumps him, curving so his shadow blocks the pass to the left centre-back.

Coaching points:
- Bait, then play into the space he left.
- Read the curve: it tells you which pass he closed.

items.text:
2 · THIRD MAN
GK → 6 → first-time
bounce to the LCB.

steps.title: 20 Game · 11v11 2-3-2-3 — Third man: GK → 6 → LCB
steps.note:
What happens:
The 6 drops between their strikers and the goalkeeper plays into him. Their midfielder jumps onto the 6’s back, so the 6 bounces it first time, back on an angle, to the left centre-back, who faces forward.

Coaching points:
- A man on your back: set first time on an angle. The shape is a V.
- The left centre-back steps out of the striker’s shadow as the first pass travels.

items.text:
3 · INTO THE SPACE
LCB plays our 8.
Their block shifts
left.

steps.title: 20 Game · 11v11 2-3-2-3 — Into the space: LCB → 8
steps.note:
What happens:
Their midfielder left his zone to press the 6. The left centre-back plays our 8 in the space behind him. Their midfield shifts across to the ball.

Coaching points:
- The 8 receives on the half-turn, already facing forward.
- The block shifts to our left: look right.

items.text:
4 · ISOLATE
The 8 switches to
the right winger,
1v1.

steps.title: 20 Game · 11v11 2-3-2-3 — Isolate: switch to the right winger
steps.note:
What happens:
The 8 received facing forward with the block on our left. He switches to the right winger, alone against their left-back.

Coaching points:
- Switch while the block is still shifted.
- Winger receives facing his defender.

items.text:
5 · GOAL · 3 POINTS
Goal + bait-and-
third-man bonus +
isolation bonus.

steps.title: 20 Game · 11v11 2-3-2-3 — 1v1, cutback, goal: 3 points
steps.note:
What happens:
The winger beats his fullback and cuts back to the 10 arriving at the penalty spot. Goal 1 + bait-and-third-man bonus 1 + isolation bonus 1 = 3 points.

Coaching points:
- Attack the defender at once.
- Cut back behind the retreating line; the 9 takes the near-post defender away.

items.text:
PROGRESS
Red change system:
4-3-3 press, then a
mid-block.

steps.title: 20 Game · 11v11 2-3-2-3 — Coaching points and progressions
steps.note:
Coaching points:
- Let the game teach: stop only for moments that show a principle, and only for 30 seconds.
- Praise the bait, the third man, the switch and the regain, not just the goal.
- At half-time ask: is the press being drawn? Who is free but hard to reach? Which side is exposed on losses?

Progressions:
- Red press in a 4-3-3 (exercise 16 problems).
- Red play a mid-block (exercise 17 problems).
- Bonuses only count if the move took fewer than 12 seconds.

Regressions:
- Red press with their front two only.
- Play 9v9 on a shorter pitch.

Dose:
2 x 10 min, 3 min rest.
